title: Wind Chimes on the Porch
description: A wooden porch at night with an ornate set of wind chimes hanging from the ceiling, surrounded by glowing concentric circles and musical staves. In the dark background, a large shadowy beast with an open red mouth lurks near the railing while a clock shows 3 o'clock on the left.
prompt: A haunting nighttime scene on a weathered wooden porch, an intricate wind chime with metal tubes hangs from the ceiling surrounded by glowing concentric circles and floating musical staves with notes. A large dark shadowy beast with glowing red open mouth lurks in the yard to the right. An old clock showing 3 o'clock is visible on the left wall. Scattered leaves and a small bell on the floor, mysterious glowing particles in the air, dark moody atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
